description: SBK Stadskarta - Hamnanläggningar is a dataset listed in Sweden's data portal, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by Stockholms stad. City map - Port facilities consisted of the following subtypes (subtypes) at the information classification 2020 (for the current list see General product specification City map):Port facilities10, berth, modifiable, active20, berth number, modifiable, active30, berth section, modifiable, active40, fender, modifiable, active50, dock, modifiable, active60, snow tapping protection, modifiable, active70, steel flaps, modifiable, active80, ramp, modifiable ... Coverage: Stockholms stad. The portal shows the English title as "SBK City map - Port facilities" (machine-translated by the portal). The publisher named on the listing is Stockholms stad. Its keywords include Fullständiga metadata, Extern dataportal. The listing shows 1 download or service links in HTML. The listing shows 2024-07-24 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support transport network, traffic and access studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-oppnadata.
